directAnswer.en: This is a site without a stable grid for a pump motor. Aggregate is 6 cm and below. A low-pressure output of ≤ 95 m³/h does not remove that cell, and delivery height is still consult the factory standard. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai lists LZ-80 at diesel 256 kW (Yuchai), high pressure ≤ 65 m³/h and low pressure ≤ 95 m³/h, high pressure ≤ 35 MPa and low pressure ≤ 22 MPa, hopper 0.6 m³, conveying distance 120 m, delivery height listed as consult factory standard, aggregate 6 cm and below, Kawasaki double 140, 6.6 × 1.8 × 1.9 m and 6800 kg. Do not move the same condition onto Diesel 120, which prints 290 kW (two units 145 kW), 100 m³/h, 40 MPa, 150 m horizontal / 500 m vertical, hopper 0.6 m³, Kawasaki 112 (two units), aggregate 6 cm and below, 7000 × 2000 × 2300 mm and 8000 kg. The photograph is a working-condition reference from a public article about this kind of work. It is not a Pinjin contract record. This page names no project, no country job, no price and no daily volume.
